note: 24 October 2026: the launderette's front worn the way the grocer's and the chandler's passed (tools/art-recipes/front_wear.py, the same settings), with this front's own places read from its model on 24 October. Its window and shop door are anodised aluminium in bronze (paint_alu_bronze, metallic 0.85: left clean, as the grocer's bronze, since the bake makes a paint non-metallic), its stallriser tiled (a picture, not a flat paint, so not baked), its shop door at the back of a recessed lobby (x -1.706 to -0.700) with brass furniture (left clean). Its paints are the cream render of the pilasters (x -3.0 to -2.65 and 2.65 to 3.0, their plinths 0 to 0.6 up and 0.18 proud) and the cornice, and the dark brown side door to the hall at the viewer's left (x -2.597 to -1.759, flush at y about -0.03), whose brass knob at x -2.178, 0.842 up is the hand's place. Only the cream plinths chip; no rail chips (the tea rooms' and the ironmonger's lesson). The dark brown is near black, so the dirt floor applies. Its fascia and box sign's two faces glow at night: their emissive maps put back after the bake (night_glow), copied from the design's build into the game's lasting inputs.
texture_px_note: one texture set per paint, its ground filled with the clean paint (Rita's lesson)

chip_regions.name: the left pilaster's plinth, by the side door

roughness_note: 22 October, the ironmonger's gate from the right: grime at roughness 0.85 caught the sky as a grey sheen at a low slant; street grime here is damp splash, so it is only a little duller than the paint.

night_glow.note: the fascia's lettering lit by tubes at night (shop-interiors.json, its front's night_glow, 0.7); the bake's round trip drops an emissive map whose factor is 0, so it is put back.
